home.title: A quiet house for children. Clarity for parents.
home.lead: Kindergarten and school share one courtyard and one language of respect — without noise, and without a cold system.
home.ctaApply: Find a place for your child
home.ganText: Full day, half day, hourly clubs, and emergency care — at a young child's pace.
home.schoolText: Small classes, Torah and general studies, and a community that stays with the child.
home.v1d: We do not rush. We do not shout. We explain.
home.v2d: The Jewish calendar is the rhythm of the week, not decoration.
home.v3d: Parents know the day — without chasing messages.
home.stat1d: Hebrew in class, English and Russian for parents.
home.stat2d: One campus, from age one to grade 6.
home.stat3d: Mehadrin, with a weekly menu in the portal.
home.quote: Our daughter comes home calm. That is all we asked for — without big words.
home.finalLead: Five minutes in the wizard, then we call — not a long form.

gan.title: A day that feels like home, with the order of a good gan
gan.lead: Four ways to stay, a stable team, and a kosher kitchen. You choose the pace. We keep the child.
gan.kitchenLead: Mehadrin kashrut. Allergies marked. The menu updates in the portal.
gan.fullD: 7:30–16:30. Play, meals, rest, and the yard.
gan.halfD: 7:30–12:30. A full morning, without afternoon rest.
gan.hourlyD: Short sessions in art, movement, and Torah.
gan.emergencyD: A single day when you suddenly need help — if a place is free.
gan.d2d: Morning circle, a song, and parsha for the age.

school.title: A small class, a clear day, an open heart
school.lead: Torah and general studies in the same house as the gan. The child grows without changing community.
school.g1d: Reading, first numbers, and a parsha that feels close.
school.g2d: Skills, personal responsibility, and helping younger children.
school.v2d: Yard every day. Prayer without pressure.

life.title: Festivals, the yard, the table, and a little quiet
life.lead: These photographs are a direction. When you arrive, you will bring your own.

about.title: Chabad education, without a performance
about.lead: We are a small house: gan and school under one roof. The aim is not a full calendar — it is that a child leaves calmer than they arrived.
about.a1: Hebrew in the classroom, respect for every home language.
about.a3: A stable team — not a rotation of strangers.

faq.title: Short answers before we talk
faq.q1: From what age do you accept children?
faq.a1: From age one through pre-school. The school begins in first grade.
faq.q2: Is there room for Russian- or English-speaking families?
faq.a2: Yes. Hebrew is the shared language on campus; staff also speak Russian and English with parents.
faq.q3: What happens if a child is ill?
faq.a3: Report in the portal, attach a note if you have one, and billing follows the tariff.
faq.q4: Can we come for a single day without a yearly contract?
faq.a4: Yes — emergency stay, subject to a free place.
faq.a5: Art, movement, music, and a parsha club. Enrol from the portal or the wizard.
faq.a6: The wizard recommends a path, then you send a request. We talk before any contract.
